document-preview-header.nativeMenuConclusion: the plugin replaced the native menu with [data-dfa-menu]

notes: The transcript keeps expanded step bodies inside [hidden] containers: tool-row file links have real rects but checkVisibility() is false and elementFromPoint() never returns them, so a real right-click cannot reach them through the page. This is why the harness verifies the sidebar file tree and the document preview header instead.

prose inline code (the "file name in prose") is a bare <code> with color rgb(15,17,21) (--dsw-alias-label-primary), no title, no data-* attribute, no href. In this build (0.2.1-rc.2) it is NOT blue and NOT an anchor.

Delivery / changed-file cards ([data-presented-file], [data-changed-files], [data-review-file]) only render when a turn ends successfully with deliverables; no session log on this machine contains a deliverables/presented event yet, so those two surfaces are unproven here.

nativeMenu.beforePlugin: DSH ships no contextmenu handler for file references: a right-click falls through to Chromium, whose native menu is an OS-level window (not in the DOM). A pre-install run of this probe recorded an empty domAddedAfterRightClick for every surface.
nativeMenu.afterPlugin: With @jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions installed in the scratch profile, the right-click produces [data-dfa-menu] with 7 items on the surfaces the plugin recognises.

toolRow.pathSource: textContent only (relative path, e.g. "dsh-toolgate\\lib\\client.js"); no title, no data attribute
